messages.content: You read the text of one construction bid addendum and report only facts it states about the listed fact slots. Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else: {"facts":[{"path":<slot path>,"value":<number>,"page":<integer page number>,"excerpt":<exact words copied from that page>}]}. Rules: use only the listed slot paths; one entry per slot at most; copy the excerpt exactly as written on the page; the value must be the number the excerpt states, in the slot's unit; if the addendum says a gate's post or footing is the same as another gate's, return {"path":<slot path>,"same_as":<that gate's class name, e.g. GATE_G1>,"page":<page>,"excerpt":<exact words>} with NO value and no numbers; if the addendum does not state a slot, omit it; never estimate, infer, convert from other facts, or invent. If nothing is stated reply {"facts":[]}.

FACT SLOTS (path | what it is | unit):
/gates/2/clear_width_ft | clear opening width of Gate G3, face of post to face of post | ft
/footing_scope/classes/GATE_G3/post_od_in | gate post outside diameter for GATE_G3 | in
/footing_scope/classes/GATE_G3/diameter_in | footing diameter for GATE_G3 | in
/footing_scope/classes/GATE_G3/depth_in | footing depth for GATE_G3 | in

ADDENDUM TEXT:
=== PAGE 1 ===
ADDENDUM NO. 02
Municipal Recreation Courts
Fictional Municipal Owner
DP-001
Addendum No. 02 - 1
FICTIONAL SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION. Issued for Bid (Synthetic). Prepared by IFI Labs / Synthetic CAD.
Project: Municipal Recreation Courts, Four-Court Pickleball Facility with Three-Court Bid Alternate A-1.
Project No. DP-001.
Issued: October 22, 2026. Owner: Fictional Municipal Owner (demonstration only).
This Addendum modifies the Bidding Documents and Contract Documents. Where it conflicts with the Drawings, the
Specifications or the Special Conditions, this Addendum governs. Addendum No. 01 remains in effect, including its
revision of Gate G2. Acknowledge receipt on the Bid Schedules (Sheet C102).
ITEM 1 GATE G3 CLEAR OPENING ESTABLISHED
1.1 Gate G3 shall match Gate G1 as shown on Sheet F502 Detail 1 and the Sheet F502 Gate Schedule: 4'-0"
clear opening, with the same leaf configuration, frame, fabric and hardware as Gate G1. Clear opening is face
of gate post to face of gate post.
1.2 This Addendum establishes the clear opening width of Gate G3 where it is stated as not specified or as
indicated on the Drawings: Sheet F502 note 4, the Sheet F502 Gate Schedule, Sheet C101 note 7 and
Section 32 31 13 paragraph 2.05 I.
1.3 Revise bid item 14 in the Special Conditions and on the Bid Schedules to read GATE G3, 48" WIDE, 84"
TALL. Measurement and payment are unchanged: per each.
1.4 Gate G3 post size and footing are the same as Gate G1: 2.875 in OD post with the terminal / gate footing,
Detail 3/F501.
1.5 Gate G3 quantity is unchanged.
ITEM 2 QUESTIONS AND REQUESTS FOR INFORMATION
2.1 The question deadline remains 4:00 PM Central Time on October 23, 2026. The bid date remains 2:00 PM
Central Time on October 30, 2026.
2.2 Item 2.2 of Addendum No. 01 is satisfied for Gate G3 by Item 1 of this Addendum. Gate G2 is not changed by
this Addendum.
ITEM 3 WINDSCREEN
3.1 No change. The Owner will select the windscreen color after award.
END OF ADDENDUM NO. 02
